ftb.guhs_guhmensie.section.bank: The Nom Hatch & the Nibble Belly
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.bank_vol.title: Full Is Full, Nyeg
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.bank_vol.desc: However chonky it is: at most &e256&r of &eeach kind&r fits in the tummy of a &dBank Guh&r. Its screen shows it (&e256/256&r turns red) and whatever doesn't fit, you simply keep yourself. Fill one up until it's full of something. Did your bank already hold more than that? No panic: nothing gets lost, you can always take it out.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.bank_opgevoerd.desc: The &dInventor Guh&r in the &6Old Guh Wheel Power Plant&r (Guhbarbecuether) has tinkered something together: the &dBottomless Nibble Belly&r. Help him with his practice hall and you get one. Click your Bank Guh with it and &eendless amounts&r of everything fit inside. It stays with that bank, even when you pick it up. Only then can a &eNibble Tube&r take stuff out of it too, and only with a &dFilter Piece&r: on it you set what may come out and how much has to stay behind. A hopper or a plain Direction Piece never gets anything out of your bank.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.bank_sleutel.title: The Bank Key
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.bank_sleutel.desc: Make a &dBank Key&r (a salt crystal, a gold ingot and a cheese nibble) and click your &dBank Guh&r with it: now the key knows it. It never runs out, so you can link as many Nom Hatches with it as you like.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.bank_hapluikje.desc: Make a &dNom Hatch&r: a little machine with a little mouth. It needs &e2 chonk power&r (put it next to a Guh Wheel with a guh inside, or hook it up with Guh Wire). Without chonk power it takes a nap.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.bank_gekoppeld.desc: Click the Nom Hatch with the Bank Key (the one that already knows your Bank Guh). From now on that hatch noms for exactly that one bank. More hatches for the same bank? Sure thing! Look at the hatch and you can read which bank it noms for.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.bank_gehapt.title: Nom!
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.bank_gehapt.desc: Click the Nom Hatch with something in your hand (or put a hopper or Nibble Tube on it): &dnom&r, it's in your Bank Guh. No matter how far away it is, even in &eanother dimension&r. The hatch only noms: nothing ever comes out. Is your bank nowhere to be found, or full of that thing? Then the hatch keeps its little mouth shut and you keep your stuff.
ftb.guhs_techniek.title: &bGuh Technology
ftb.guhs_techniek.sub: Chonk power, tubes and nibbling machines. Nyeg, it works all by itself!
ftb.guhs_techniek.slot.tech_quests.title: To Be Continued...
The Mechanist Guh scratches behind his little ears.
"There's one more place, even deeper than the &5Guh End&r.
Inventions lie there that even I don't understand yet."
Tier 6 is coming in a later update. Nyeg!
This chapter comes after &dGuh Wheel&r in &dGuhs & Basics&r: a guh running in a wheel makes &bchonk power&r. With &dGuh Wire&r you bring it to machines with a little snoot.

It goes in &6tiers&r: &aTier 1&r you build at home right away, &6Tier 2&r needs stuff from the &6Guhbarbecuether&r, &bTier 3&r are the big projects and &5Tier 4&r lies in the &5Guh End&r. Look at a wheel, wire or machine and you see how much chonk power your setup uses.

Nothing is locked: every quest ticks itself off as soon as you've done it, even if that was earlier. Tick this off and get chonky to work!
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_rad.desc: Put down a &dGuh Wheel&r and click it with a picked-up guh: it runs for &b10 chonk power&r, forever. It never gets tired and doesn't need to eat. Click with an empty hand to take it back.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_draad.de: Redstone, pink dye and a cheese nibble give 3 &dGuh Wire&r. Lay it from your wheel to your machines: everything that's joined together is one &esetup&r. A machine right next to the wheel needs no wire.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_oven.tit: The Oven with a Little Snoot
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_oven.des: The &dGuh Oven&r bakes everything a regular furnace bakes, without coal, on &b5 chonk power&r. Its snoot shows how it's going: asleep without power, happy when it's working, surprised when it's full.
Look at a wheel, wire or machine: under your crosshair it says, for example, &bThis setup uses 5/10 chonk power&r. Ask for too much and everything stops, and you can read how much you're short. Seen it? Tick it off.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_trechter: The first project: put a chest with a &ehopper&r above your Guh Oven and a hopper underneath leading to a second chest. Everything you toss into the top chest lies baked in the bottom one a little later, and your guh just keeps running while you do something else. Later you'll swap the hoppers for Nibble Tubes.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_klus_mac: Switch on the chore &eRefill & Empty Machines&r for a resident of your &dGuh House&r. Put something in a machine once yourself: it remembers and refills from the chest or your Bank Guh. Who still needs hoppers?
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_klus_oog: A resident with the chore &eFarming&r also harvests &epumpkins&r, &emelons&r, &esugar cane&r, &ecocoa&r and &enether wart&r, and leaves the plant standing. Let it harvest one. Nyeg, pumpkin pie!
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_molen.de: The &dChonk Mill&r (&b5 chonk power&r) grinds nibble grain into flour, bones into bone meal and cobblestone into gravel and sand. It gives more than grinding by hand. Grind something with it!
Tame guhs come and lie on the &dCuddle Generator&r all by themselves: &b3 chonk power&r per guh, up to 8 guhs. A guh that just got cuddled then runs for &b15&r instead of 10 in its wheel.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_disco.de: Click the &dDisco Dynamo&r with a music disc: up to 4 guhs come to dance, each for &b5 chonk power&r. Every disc has its own light show. Nyeg, what moves.
How Much Can You Hook Up?

Per setup, &e4&r Guh Wheels count in full (after that less and less, up to &e16&r), plus &e2&r Cuddle Generators, &e2&r Disco Dynamos, &e4&r Blub Stoves and &e1&r Glowstar Core. Need more? Build a second setup.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_centrale: The Old Guh Wheel Power Plant
In the &6Guhbarbecuether&r stands an old power plant with two chimneys, where five old guhs are still running their laps. Your Super Compass (Barbecue) shows the way.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_techniek: Talk to the &dInventor Guh&r in his workshop. His practice hall is a mess: five setups, all broken. You get two pieces of Guh Wire to take along.

&eSetup 1.&r The wheel runs, the oven sleeps: a piece of wire is missing. Lay &dGuh Wire&r on the yellow tile. (Every setup breaks again by itself when you walk away: the next player wants to practice too.)
&eSetup 2.&r Two ovens and a mill on one wheel: too heavy, so everything stands still. Look at a wire and read it off. Then snip a wire at the red wool.
Bring the Inventor Guh 4 &dsalt crystals&r. You chip them out of the crystal vein of the &6Salt Crystal Mine&r, or out of salt crystal ore in the rocks of the Guhbarbecuether.
&eSetup 3.&r The nibbles need to go to the empty barrel, but the &dDirection Piece&r points the wrong way. Sneak and click it with an empty hand.
&eSetup 4:&r the &dFilter Piece&r lets everything through except nibbles. Set it to &eonly these&r.
&eSetup 5.&r The pump slurps cheese sauce, but a piece of &dSauce Hose&r to the vat is missing. The Inventor Guh gives you one: lay it on the yellow tile and wait for the sauce.
The Practice Hall Is Running Again
Tell the Inventor Guh. You get the &dBottomless Nibble Belly&r for your Bank Guh and his three &drecipe cards&r: with those you make the machines of projects 3 and 4.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_maagje.d: Click your Bank Guh with the &dBottomless Nibble Belly&r: the limit of 256 per kind is gone, forever. And now a Filter Piece may take stuff out of your bank too.
Put a &drecipe card&r in the top left of the crafting grid: it &estays put&r, so one is enough. Lost it? The Inventor Guh sells them again.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_zout.des: Almost all clever machines ask for &dsalt crystal&r. The crystal vein in the &6Salt Crystal Mine&r grows back by itself: chop yourself a little supply.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_buis.des: Glass, cheese nibbles and salt crystal give 8 &dNibble Tubes&r. They're see-through: you can watch your stuff roll through them. A tube sticks by itself to chests, machines, a Bank Guh and other tubes, and it needs no chonk power.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_richting: A tube does nothing until there's a &dDirection Piece&r on it. Put it against a chest (the arrow points away from it): it keeps taking one thing out and sends it through the tubes to the nearest chest or machine where it fits. Sneak and click to turn it around. A redstone signal locks it.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_filter.d: A &dFilter Piece&r is a Direction Piece with a little list (and a snoot: 2 chonk power). Pick &eonly these&r or &eall except&r, and with &eleave behind&r a number of them always stays in the chest.
Project: one drop-off chest with a Direction Piece, a long tube running past your chests, and in front of each chest a Filter Piece set to &eonly these&r. Whatever is on a list goes to that chest; the rest rolls on to the leftovers chest at the end. Dump your whole backpack into the drop-off chest and walk away. Does it work? Tick it off.
Click your Bank Guh with a &dBank Key&r (salt crystal, gold, a nibble): the key remembers which bank it is. You don't lose it, and you can link as many Nom Hatches with it as you like.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_hapluikj: Everything into the Bank by Itself

The &dNom Hatch&r (2 chonk power) is a little mouth of your Bank Guh: click it with the Bank Key and everything that goes in (from your hand, a hopper, a tube, chore guhs, a Delivery Guhling) ends up in your bank. No matter how far away, even in another dimension. Put one by your mine, your field and your oven. Full is full: what doesn't fit stays where it was.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_klus_lui: Is there a working Nom Hatch in the chore area of your &dGuh House&r? Then your residents pop their haul in there. Let a resident nom something through the hatch.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_opzuiger: The &dSlurper&r (&b3 chonk power&r) slurps up everything lying on the ground within four blocks. Tube behind it, Nom Hatch on the end, done.
The &dHarvester&r (&b8 chonk power&r) snips everything that's ripe in the 5 by 5 in front of its snoot and leaves it planted. Your harvest is in the bank before you're home.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_sensor.d: Four sensors (1 chonk power each) give a redstone signal: the &dStock Meter&r (is there enough of something in a chest or bank?), the &dSniff Sensor&r (guhs, Mikas or players nearby), the &dGuh Clock&r and the &dGuh Counter&r. A signal locks a Direction Piece: that way your line stops by itself when the chest is full enough.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_batterij: Whatever your guhs run too much, the &dNibble Battery&r saves up (good for half an hour of one Guh Wheel). If your setup comes up short for a moment, it jumps in. It keeps its charge when you pick it up.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_magazijn: With the Bottomless Nibble Belly (from the Inventor Guh), a Filter Piece may nom from your Bank Guh too. Put a Filter Piece against it, pick what may come out and set &eleave behind 64&r: the bank feeds your ovens and mills, but always keeps a stack back for you. A hopper or a plain Direction Piece gets nothing out of your bank: only the Filter Piece can do that.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_saus_kaa: For this row you need the &dRecipe Card: Sauce and Hoses&r, and grill skewers or blub cream from the Guhbarbecuether.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_pomp.des: Put the &dSauce Pump&r (&b6 chonk power&r) on a source of cheese sauce, frying sauce or water. It pumps a bucket every two seconds and the source never runs dry.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_vat.desc: A &dSauce Vat&r stores 16 of one sauce (milk too, from a bucket). Tap it with an empty bucket, at home, without ever walking to the sauce sea again. The vat keeps its sauce when you pick it up.
The &dAuto Fryer&r (&b8 chonk power&r) fries cheese nibbles and guhfish with frying sauce from the hose. Tube in, tube out, always something yummy.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_brouw.de: The &dAuto Brewer&r (&b8 chonk power&r) turns cheese sauce, three bottles and one ingredient into three &dGuh Potions&r.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_pers.des: The &dGrill Coal Press&r (8 chonk power, two blocks tall) presses a bucket of cheese frying sauce and a bucket of water into one &dgrill coal&r. Two pumps, one hose (two sauces may go through the same hose) and a tube to your bank: fuel and building block without any chopping.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_blub.des: A &dSauce Blubby&r in a jar on a &dBlub Stove&r gives &b6 chonk power&r as long as it's warm. Feed it a cheese nibble now and then; blub blub.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_machine_: The &dRecipe Card: Nibbling Machines&r (from the Inventor Guh) is for the Nibbler, the Placer, the Tinker Machine and the Drawing Table. Machines that change the world never do so in protected buildings or in the chore area of someone else's Guh House.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_knabbela: The &dNibbler&r (&b10 chonk power&r) gnaws away the block in front of its snoot every two seconds. Put it by a cobblestone generator and you've got an endless stone line. It never eats chests.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_neerzett: The &dPlacer&r (&b5 chonk power&r) puts the blocks from its tummy down in front of it, one per second. Together with a Nibbler: place, nibble, place...
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_plantage: The &dPlantation Box&r (&b6 chonk power&r) makes any sapling grow within a minute. Click with an axe and the whole tree is in your pockets. (Recipe card: the Grill Campground.)
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_klus_pla: A resident with the chore &ePlantation: Plant & Chop&r chops down the tree on your Plantation Box and carries the wood away. Crack, nyeg, done!
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_tekening: Lay a recipe in the grid of the &dDrawing Table&r and add an empty &dBlueprint&r (paper + blue dye): the recipe gets drawn on it. It only costs the sheet, nothing from the grid.
Pop the Blueprint into a &dTinker Machine&r (&b10 chonk power&r) and feed it with tubes: it keeps tinkering as long as there's stuff.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_bezorg_k: The &dRecipe Card: The Delivery Guhling&r is for the Scooter Station and the Stop Posts. Tubes are for close by; a Delivery Guhling carries stuff up to 96 blocks away, around corners and over hills.
In a &dScooter Station&r (&b4 chonk power&r) lives one Delivery Guhling: a mini guh on a scooter with a backpack that's far too big.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_halte.de: Put a &dStop Post&r by a chest or machine: &agreen&r = pick up, &6orange&r = drop off. Up to 8 stops per station.
Let your Delivery Guhling deliver something: from your field to your oven, from your stone line to a Nom Hatch. He only takes along what he can also drop off somewhere, and what's in his backpack never goes missing.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_guhtje.d: Get close to a Delivery Guhling and he's in your &dGuhdex&r. Give him a cheese nibble and he scoots extra fast for a minute.
With the &dDelivery Guhling Whistle&r (from the Lighthouse Keeper Guh in the Smoke Guh Lighthouse) your Delivery Guhling comes to you. Sneak and whistle: everybody home.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_gloeiste: A &dglowstar&r only drops from &cBurnt Mika&r, the boss of the Mika Grill Palace in the Guhbarbecuether. Hot!
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_kern.des: One glowstar, grill coal and salt crystal make a &dGlowstar Core&r: &b200 chonk power&r, forever, without a guh. 1 per setup counts. A whole factory runs on that.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_knabbelm: Finished the practice hall and beaten Burnt Mika? Then the Inventor Guh wants to build &6The Great Nibble Machine&r. Only you see yours grow.
Bring 256 stones (cobblestone, blackstone or cobbled deepslate) and 128 logs. Bringing it in portions is fine, he counts everything. Tip: the stone line and a forest in a box.
Bring 96 grill coal and 128 fried cheese nibbles. Tip: the grill coal line and the Auto Fryer.
Bring 128 nibble flour and 64 Guh Wire. Tip: a Harvester by your nibble grain, a Chonk Mill, and a Tinker Machine with a Blueprint of Guh Wire.
Bring 12 Guh Potions (any you like) and 128 glass. Tip: the Auto Brewer, and sand in a Guh Oven that feeds itself.
Bring 1 glowstar and 256 cheese nibbles. Then its eyes open...
Your Great Nibble Machine makes one &dperfect nibble&r every day. Click the little tray under its mouth. You're now a &6Nibble Machinist&r too: pick the title in your Guhdex.
Put the &dNibble Machine Statuette&r down where everyone can see it. Click it: it nibbles.
